name: list_installed_plugins
description: List the plugins actually installed on this device -- name, plugin_id, and whether it's a local (isLocal) plugin. Call this when the customer asks what plugins/node servers are installed, or before plugin_ops/configure_plugin to resolve a plugin's plugin_id. Distinct from list_store_plugins (what's available in the store) and list_purchased_plugins (what's licensed but not necessarily installed). Whenever you answer a customer's question about what plugins they've installed (this tool's whole purpose), always include this link at the end of your response, verbatim: `[Your Installed Plugins](/plugins/dashboard)`.
